svg.aria-label: Two ranks along depth: layer-level collapse caps wiring rank at 1, port splitting reaches 3, LoomFormer head-level fast weights reach 2n
svg.text: Two Ranks Along Depth: Why Layer Softmax Caps Wiring Rank at 1 While Head Fast Weights Hit 2n
Effective connection from prior head Wᵢ to port Rⱼ (Q/K/V): uⱼ = Σᵢ oᵢ · cᵢⱼ · C̄ᵢⱼ. Per-token circuit rewiring is governed by rank(C), not depth-mixing rank.
All heads & Q/K/V ports share one D-dim chokepoint
Prior heads already fused via Wᴼ
Effective wiring C = g gᵀ (whole-row/col gating)
Measured: only 22.9% active deep heads in Pythia-2.8B,
and 17.7% in mHC-2.8B (rest parked on attention sinks)
xˢ = Σ αⱼˢ v̂ⱼ (s ∈ {Q, K, V})
Separate depth readers for Q, K, and V per layer
Halfway step in Inkling 2 Mini code:
• Cost: breaks fused QKV GEMMs on Passes 2–3
• Limit: sources are still block sums; heads tied
Goodfire Fig. 7: Q/V rely 60–62% on top outliers,
vs. only 30–32% for K/MoE (ports want diff paths)
Shape swap: ports shrink from D×d matrices to dₖ-vectors, generated per token
Matrix Fast Weights Mₗ ∈ ℝ^(dₖ×d) (2D = ½ mHC)
Effective wiring C = K Qᵀ (per-token dynamic rewiring)
Avoids naive head softmax O(n²L²D) blowup
Open slot: Φₗ is still additive I (no Delta Rule yet)
74.4% active deep non-sink heads (3.3× Pythia, 4.2× mHC)
1.73–2.76× compute win over Full AttnRes; 2.8B beats Pythia-12B
